items.title: Canada’s Carney embraces tighter ties with E.U. despite Trump warning
items.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney addressed European lawmakers after E.U. officials said Canada could become the bloc’s first “associate member.”

items.title: Germany sending fighter jets to Latvia to protect election from drone incidents
items.summary: Germany will send four Eurofighter jets to defend Latvian airspace during upcoming elections, amid concerns over drone incursions from Russia and Belarus.

items.title: Sweden Swings Back Left, Bucking a Trend in Europe
items.summary: The results of this week’s exceptionally close election dealt a blow to far-right nationalists, who have gained ground elsewhere.

items.title: Carney says Canada will decide its own partnerships after Trump calls EU proposal ‘laughable’
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump had described the prospect of Canada becoming the first associate member of the EU as "laughable."
